\frac{d^2 v_c}{dt^2} + \frac{1}{LC} v_c = 0 \quad \text{(1.16)}
$$  
The solution to this equation involves complex roots $ s = \pm j\omega_0 $, where $ \omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}} $ [SOURCE 3]. The voltage response becomes a linear combination of sinusoidal functions:  
$$
v_c(t) = B_1 \cos(\omega_0 t) + B_2 \sin(\omega_0 t) \quad \text{(1.21)}
$$  
This indicates sustained oscillations at the resonant frequency $ \omega_0 $ without damping, as resistance approaches zero [SOURCE 3].
